Context: 10. T.A. on Transfer

- (c) Department of Posts.Posting to a place of choice on completion of full tenure may not be normally termed as transfer on own request under SR 114. Officials transferred after completion of full tenure as prescribed from time to time to the place of their choice will be entitled for T.A. and transit. - Dept. of Posts, No. 17-3/94-PAP, dated 18-12-1995.
